evidence.reason: Left edit replaces the literal "work" with "benchmark" in the call to reminders.evaluate, changing the calendar argument that callers and tests previously relied on (test asserts evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0).

Right edit adds reminderDelayV2 which is value-referenced by evaluate; it mutates shared history via history.splice and defaults multiplier to configuration.rate, introducing new stateful behavior into the evaluate path.
Existing test asserts evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0 and scheduledDelay(40) > 0, but does not cover the "benchmark" calendar or reminderDelayV2, so the merged behavior is not jointly validated.

result.userExplanation: 合并后 scheduledDelay 传入的日历参数由 "work" 变为 "benchmark"，而 evaluate 又引用了新增的 reminderDelayV2，可能改变既有调用方依赖的延迟计算，但缺少 evaluate 实现与 calendar 语义，无法确认是否安全。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/scheduling.ts#scheduledDelay 的维护者确认 "benchmark" 是否为合法日历值；若不是，应改回 "work" 或显式传入受支持的日历参数，并补充覆盖 reminderDelayV2 与 "benchmark" 分支的测试。
